verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests a free path that keeps history. Self-hosted Zulip runs the same software as Zulip Cloud (zulip-docs-8), is 100% FOSS (zulip-comm-8), and does not charge for features like SAML or LDAP (zulip-docs-15). That implies a team could stay free by self-hosting without feature gating, but nothing explicitly addresses message-history limits. missing for 10: explicit documentation of free-tier message-history retention or search limits on Zulip Cloud, an explicit statement that self-hosted free use keeps full history, and independent hands-on corroboration.
